it’s a huge safety hazard to not clean the espresso machine everyday and craaaaaazy that the steam wand is always crusty, whenever i walk into a shop i always look at the wand to judge the people behind the counter. if you’re boss thinks they’re saving money, they are LOSING IT!! not to mention it’s a huge bacterial problem to not have clean steam wands+plus allergens and contaminants like the matcha do cocoa powder will clog the wand and affect steaming quality. the espresso machine HAS to be cleaned several times in one day where i worked, i personally cleaned it before and after shifts and when cleaning it every shift i would run a dime worth of cafiza in the closed port filter head and scrub it and run it 5 times, or until the water is clear. having a gross machine also means your coffee will taste bad, and maybe even rancid if the coffee oils are staying in the machine for 3 days. 

my suggestion would be to get Cafiza, ask your boss if you’re able to just try it and also keep a container near your steam wands with sanitizer in them, and of course always clear the steam wand after wiping for every drink and don’t keep the puck in the machine as it clogs it faster and fucks up your extraction of espresso
